d:
A historic verdict has put Myanmar in the spotlight. The International Court of Justice (ICJ) has held Myanmar responsible for the genocide of the Rohingya Muslim minority, marking a significant moment in the long struggle for justice.
But how did a small African nation, The Gambia, take Myanmar to the world's highest court? Why did the Rohingya flee their homes in 2017? And more importantly, will this landmark verdict actually bring justice to millions of displaced people?
